caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a metallic tool consisting of a long, straight handle attached to a cylindrical cage-like basket at one end. The handle is brown with a slightly reddish hue and extends horizontally across the image from the left to the right, angling upward toward the end where it connects to the basket. The basket is constructed from vertical and horizontal metal bars, giving it an open, grid-like appearance and a dark brown to almost black coloration. A small metal bracket attaches the handle to the rim of the basket. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige, and the only visible text is at the lower left, reading "IVAR JULIUS 1937" in capital letters. The composition is simple, with the object centered and occupying most of the horizontal space, leaving ample empty background around it.
title: Flambeau
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
